<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>RBI Policy and Market Recovery:</strong> The RBI maintained the repo rate, while projecting a 6.9% real GDP growth for FY27, providing a stable backdrop as the Sensex and Nifty rebounded significantly on renewed FII inflows.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxNcXhVYzVVYzVxM3FZZXh2RUpCN1ZsSjZnU09reVVIeGZCT2ZfSklDTnVkTHVhcmx5NEZVaUNsUFRCbVk3RkF2YWZXaHNUUkgyR2ZHLTJmbWlLNFluWDBESFdBSGt2a3hvbFFRZ2hFNmRMbzk0MWFRaDNHMk5lOUtldm4xdnJUNHJadHhYRlo3MWVfZw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I21</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxOTGFSNzg0VzlJdnMwYWh2TzliX3libXhnd0pFajdsbW05R3dZU3Y5V3BjRU5uV2Q0aDVOZWZNX3dDdHpvNXpGOXRTQlNnQVRScklzNU5QdjVmV2YzOWlFVWZXMXFSZWxscFJIdFY0UHhleHZreWhkRmhqNGpCeTBYTVlpZ3AxcFN5X0h6SkFqSHJzSTBhWER6N1lkQXB3cnlLRXU4TF95ZjNWdC01XzBkTm0zOGN3RmpXc1lQSkdR?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I23</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiyAFBVV95cUxPSlNfR2tKazFfaFotN2RQMmJwekhTUEREa09OQWkyQ1cyOHRScE1XcHhUNXVxT2t2a3A5SXZILTlIcFlTQlVESmlkYm1JTmNkQmVwcTc0Y0VvQ1VRUEd6SmJ4QS0wRTZSTWRyYjNmaXJfRjUwQXdzc3l3YVlBQl9GaXlvYV94WHRvV1dMeWhKbmxlWWdXYkNkX1FFWXNyVzNyVmxDQUVSeHJNRWg1NDBVRGNvTjVaQVdyVkxxbjhNNFd3OGZIelloQQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I25</a></span></li>
